full_prompt_en: A square anime-style illustration shows two young figures in right-facing profile, with the nearer face framed by a large red-orange mechanical helmet against a subdued blue-gray background. A thin pale border encloses the scene. The main figure occupies most of the left and center, cropped closely at the top and bottom. Copper-colored hair escapes from beneath the helmet and falls in short locks around a visible blue eye. The eye looks steadily to the right, while the straight nose and small closed mouth give the face a composed, alert expression. Angular blue-gray armor surrounds the ear, cheek, and neck, its edges catching narrow pale highlights. Above it, broad red-orange plates overlap in sharp facets and sweep toward the upper-right corner. Small teal insets, black mechanical gaps, and a yellow horizontal rod interrupt the warm shell. In the lower right, a second, smaller figure stands just behind the first. Dark hair protrudes from a green cap, and the tan face turns in the same direction, creating a repeated profile rhythm at two scales. Only a narrow section of the second person's light clothing is visible. The background remains largely flat and quiet, emphasizing the two heads and the detailed machinery. Precise dark outlines hold the character features, while subtle internal linework and shaded planes give the armor weight. Strong directional light from the upper left creates cream highlights on the red plates and face, with blue-gray shadows under the shell and along the jaw. The palette balances hot vermilion and copper against cooler teal, slate blue, and muted green. No readable lettering appears. The overall composition is tight and forward-looking, using layered profiles and vivid hard-surface shapes to build a sense of poised action.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形动画风格插画呈现两名年轻人物面朝右侧的侧影，近处面孔被巨大的红橙色机械头盔框住，背景为低调的蓝灰色。一道细浅色边框围住场景。主体人物占据左侧与中央大部分画面，上下均被贴近裁切。铜色短发从头盔下露出，落在一只可见的蓝眼睛旁。眼睛坚定地望向右方，直鼻梁和闭合的小嘴让表情显得镇定而警觉。棱角分明的蓝灰色护甲围住耳朵、面颊与颈部，边缘接住狭窄浅色高光。其上，宽阔的红橙甲片以锐利切面重叠，并向右上角伸展。小块青绿色嵌件、黑色机械缝隙和一根黄色水平杆打断暖色外壳。右下方，第二名较小的人物位于主体稍后。深发从绿帽下露出，棕褐色脸朝同一方向，形成两种尺度重复的侧脸节奏。只能看见第二人一小部分浅色衣服。背景大体平坦安静，强调两张脸和精细机械结构。精确深色轮廓稳定人物五官，内部细线与阴影色面则使护甲有重量。来自左上方的强定向光在红色甲片与脸上留下奶油色高光，外壳下方及下颌沿线留着蓝灰影。配色以炽热朱红和铜色平衡较冷的青绿、板岩蓝与低饱和绿。没有可读文字。整体构图紧密而面向前方，以层叠侧影和鲜明的硬表面形状营造蓄势待发的感觉。
style_prompt_en: The anime illustration combines clean expressive linework with layered hard-edged color planes. Saturated red-orange masses dominate, while teal, slate blue, muted green, and narrow cream highlights cool and articulate them. Large faceted forms overlap smaller mechanical details, producing a hierarchy that reads quickly despite dense design. Curved organic contours sit beside angular constructed edges, and repeated directional profiles lead the eye across the square. Cel-like shadow zones are decisive rather than smoothly blended, yet thin internal strokes add material texture and depth. A fairly quiet background prevents the intricate foreground from becoming visually scattered. Upper-side illumination picks out ridges and leaves darker joints and recesses underneath. The overall effect is energetic, precise, and cinematic, with bold color separation and sharp silhouette control carrying the style.
style_prompt_zh: 这种动画插画把干净有表现力的线条与层叠的硬边色面结合。饱和红橙色体量占主导，青绿、板岩蓝、低饱和绿和狭窄奶油色高光使它们降温并显出结构。大的切面形状重叠在较小的机械细节之上，形成即使设计密集也能迅速读清的层级。有机曲线轮廓与棱角构造边缘并置，重复的定向侧影引导视线横穿方画幅。近似赛璐璐的阴影区域果断而非平滑混合，细密内部笔痕又增加材料肌理和纵深。相对安静的背景避免复杂前景在视觉上散乱。上侧光照亮凸起脊线，让下方关节与凹处保持较暗。整体效果有活力、精确且具电影感，醒目的颜色分隔和锐利剪影控制承载风格。
theme_en: Two anime pilots in profile beneath a large red mechanical helmet
theme_zh: 巨大红色机械头盔下的两名动画驾驶员侧影
name: Gainax
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
